questions.title: Highest Sugar Beet Production
questions.prompt: Name the US states that produce the most sugar beets by tons.
questions.disclaimer: Sugar beet root tonnage harvested for processing; short tons. DC not included (source omits it).

questions.title: Highest Egg Production
questions.prompt: Name the US states that produce the most chicken eggs.
questions.disclaimer: Total table + hatching eggs from layers; measured in millions of eggs annually. DC not included (topic is state-scoped).

questions.title: Highest Milk Production
questions.prompt: Name the US states that produce the most cow's milk by pounds.
questions.disclaimer: Total cow's milk production; measured in pounds annually. DC not included (topic is state-scoped).

questions.title: Highest Broiler Chicken Production
questions.prompt: Name the US states that produce the most broiler chickens by pounds of live weight.
questions.disclaimer: Broilers are meat chickens; measured in pounds of live weight produced annually. DC not included (topic is state-scoped).

source.name: USDA NASS — Poultry Production and Value

questions.title: Highest Turkey Production
questions.prompt: Name the US states that raise the most turkeys by head count.
questions.disclaimer: Number of turkeys raised annually. DC not included (topic is state-scoped).

questions.title: Highest Honey Production
questions.prompt: Name the US states that produce the most honey by pounds.
questions.disclaimer: Honey production from colonies with 5 or more hives; measured in pounds. DC not included (topic is state-scoped).

questions.title: Highest Maple Syrup Production
questions.prompt: Name the US states that produce the most maple syrup by gallons.
questions.disclaimer: Finished maple syrup, standard density; measured in gallons. DC not included (topic is state-scoped).

questions.title: Most Toll Road Mileage
questions.prompt: Name the US states with the most toll road mileage (public toll roads, in miles).
questions.disclaimer: Miles of public toll roads (mainline toll facilities). Excludes toll bridges and tunnels reported separately. DC not included (topic is state-scoped).

source.name: FHWA — Highway Statistics, Table HM-18 (Toll Facilities)

questions.title: Most Traffic Fatalities (Total)
questions.prompt: Name the US states with the most total traffic fatalities in a recent year.
questions.disclaimer: Absolute counts, not adjusted for population or vehicle miles traveled. Includes Washington DC.

questions.title: Highest Traffic Fatality Rate per 100M VMT
questions.prompt: Name the US states with the highest traffic fatality rate per 100 million vehicle miles traveled.
questions.disclaimer: Deaths per 100 million VMT normalizes for how much driving each state actually does. Includes Washington DC.

source.name: NHTSA — Traffic Safety Facts, State Fatality Rates

questions.title: Longest Average Commute Time
questions.prompt: Name the US states (including DC) with the longest mean commute time to work.
questions.disclaimer: Mean travel time to work (minutes), one-way, workers age 16+. Includes Washington DC.

source.name: US Census Bureau — American Community Survey 1-Year Estimates, Table B08303

questions.title: Highest Bike-to-Work Share
questions.prompt: Name the US states (including DC) where the largest share of commuters bike to work.
questions.disclaimer: Share of workers age 16+ whose primary means of commuting is bicycle. Includes Washington DC.

source.name: US Census Bureau — ACS 1-Year, Table B08301 (Means of Transportation)

questions.title: Highest Walk-to-Work Share
questions.prompt: Name the US states (including DC) where the largest share of commuters walk to work.
questions.disclaimer: Share of workers age 16+ whose primary commute mode is walking. Includes Washington DC.

source.name: US Census Bureau — ACS 1-Year, Table S0801

questions.title: Most Registered Motor Vehicles
questions.prompt: Name the US states with the most registered motor vehicles (cars, trucks, buses, motorcycles).
questions.disclaimer: All registered motor vehicles, including personal, commercial, and government fleets. Includes Washington DC.

questions.title: Most EV Charging Station Locations
questions.prompt: Name the US states with the most public electric-vehicle charging station locations.
questions.disclaimer: Distinct public charging station locations (any level, any port count). Private/residential chargers excluded. Includes Washington DC.

source.name: US DOE — Alternative Fuels Data Center (AFDC) Station Locator

questions.title: Most DC Fast-Charging Ports
questions.prompt: Name the US states with the most public DC fast-charging (Level 3) ports for electric vehicles.
questions.disclaimer: Public DC fast-charging (Level 3) ports, including Tesla Supercharger stalls that are publicly accessible. Level 2 chargers excluded.

source.name: US DOE — Alternative Fuels Data Center (AFDC)
